theme_and_archetype.reasoning: The application is a data-heavy B2B internal tool for a construction company. It requires extreme clarity, authority, and function-first design. The 'Godly' architectural design standard prioritizes zero-friction navigation, precision, and raw structural integrity.

typography.rules: The Anti-Default Rule applies. Inter is strictly banned for headings.

colors.contrast_rules: Strict APCA/WCAG AA compliance. Dark text on light backgrounds. Color is used ONLY for status (status badges, charts) and primary actions. Never for decoration.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: MODE B: THE 'CONTROL ROOM' GRID (For Dashboards). Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). High density.
spacing_and_layout.spacing_scale: p-4, p-6, p-8. Use generous internal padding within data cards to prevent clutter.
spacing_and_layout.surface_strategy: GRID BORDERS (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton. Container uses border-collapse style layout. Items have 1px solid borders (border-zinc-200). NO soft drop shadows. Use flat, hard-edged containers with max 4px border-radius (rounded-sm).
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align all data tables, form inputs, and labels. Right-align numerical values in tables (rates, totals, stock quantities).

component_rules.general: Always use pure HTML+Tailwind for layout shells. Use heavily customized Shadcn components for interactive elements.
component_rules.tables: Crucial for Inward/Outward entries and Stock Register. Use sticky headers. Dense rows. Alternating row colors (zinc-50/white) for scanability.
component_rules.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Select, and Calendar (for invoice dates). Labels must be bold. Input fields should have crisp 1px borders, turning blue on focus.
component_rules.cards: Avoid default Shadcn Card shadow. Override with shadow-none and border-zinc-200.
component_rules.buttons: Primary: Solid Industrial Blue. Secondary: Outline with transparent background, black text, and grey border. Danger: Solid Signal Red.
component_rules.navigation: Fixed sidebar for desktop (multi-site selector at the top), sticky top header for mobile. The site selector must be a highly visible dropdown.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons must change brightness on hover. Table rows must have hover:bg-zinc-100.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Fast and snappy. transition-colors duration-150 ease-in-out.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Use skeleton loaders for dashboard charts and tables. No playful spinners.

icons_and_assets.library: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) - Best for dense dashboards and industrial precision.
icons_and_assets.usage: Use icons sparingly. Primarily in the sidebar navigation, status badges, and action buttons (e.g., Export CSV).

backgrounds_and_heroes.description: Modern concrete construction site overhead view. Use for Login screen background with a heavy bg-white/80 overlay.
Industrial racks and structures. Alternate login background.

logos.description: Minimalist placeholder logo for the construction firm if needed for invoices.

avatars.description: Avatar for Site Manager / User profile.

testing_requirements.data_testid_rule: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute. Use kebab-case and role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='inward-entry-row-1', data-testid='site-selector-dropdown').

instructions_to_main_agent.file_extensions: CRITICAL: Use .js (and .jsx semantics inside .js) for all React files. DO NOT use .tsx or .ts files.
instructions_to_main_agent.styling_engine: Tailwind CSS + customized Shadcn UI primitives. Stick strictly to the Archetype 4 design system.
instructions_to_main_agent.key_features: Ensure Low/High stock analysis handles both manual per-item thresholds AND auto-calculated limits from consumption history. Export to CSV/Excel is mandatory for inventory, invoices, and consumption.
instructions_to_main_agent.multi_site: Implement a global context or state for the 'Selected Site'. Admins see aggregate, users see restricted views.
instructions_to_main_agent.dependencies_to_install: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react recharts date-fns react-day-picker clsx tailwind-merge
